title.en: Complexity of Clathrin Coat Dynamics in Endocytosis
title.zh: 内吞过程中网格蛋白包被动态变化的复杂性

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis is a process by which eukaryotic cells internalise a wide range of molecules such as signalling factors, nutrients and membrane proteins, via the formation of a plasma-membrane-derived vesicle. This complex mechanism involves a coordinated assembly of the scaffold protein clathrin and more than 50 other endocytic proteins at endocytic sites. Clathrin polymerises into sturdy supramolecular lattices, yet its assembly is highly dynamic and controlled by the DnaJ/Hsc70 uncoating machinery. Although clathrin turnover at endocytic sites was proposed early on to allow membrane deformation to occur, more recent studies have started hinting at possible regulatory functions. In this review, we summarise and discuss the key findings that have advanced our understanding of the role played by clathrin dynamics, hoping to shed light on the complex regulation of the endocytic process.
abstract.zh: 网格蛋白介导的内吞作用是指真核细胞通过形成源自质膜的囊泡，将信号因子、营养物质和膜蛋白等多种分子内化的过程。这一复杂机制涉及支架蛋白网格蛋白及另外50多种内吞相关蛋白在内吞位点的协同组装。网格蛋白聚合形成坚固的超分子晶格，但其组装具有高度动态性，并受DnaJ/Hsc70脱包被机制调控。早期有人提出，内吞位点的网格蛋白周转使膜变形得以发生；近期研究则开始提示其可能具有调节功能。本综述总结并讨论了推进我们理解网格蛋白动态变化作用的关键发现，希望阐明内吞过程的复杂调控。

title.en: Transpapillary Placement of a Multihole Covered Metal Stent Using a 5.9-Fr Delivery System Through a Forward-viewing Endoscope in Malignant Biliary Obstruction With Type I Duodenal Stenosis
title.zh: 恶性胆道梗阻合并Ⅰ型十二指肠狭窄时，经前视内镜使用5.9 Fr输送系统跨乳头置入多孔覆膜金属支架

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Concurrent malignant biliary obstruction (MBO) and type I duodenal stenosis represent a technically demanding scenario, as luminal narrowing frequently precludes passage of a standard side-viewing duodenoscope and limits conventional transpapillary drainage. Although endoscopic ultrasound-guided biliary drainage and percutaneous transhepatic biliary drainage are established alternative approaches, transpapillary drainage remains desirable when papillary access is achievable. We report a 66-year-old woman with stage IV pancreatic cancer who presented with obstructive jaundice and tumor-related type I duodenal stenosis (i.e., obstruction proximal to the papilla). A side-viewing duodenoscope failed to traverse the stenosis; however, a standard forward-viewing endoscope (GIF-Q260J) successfully reached the major papilla. Selective biliary cannulation was achieved, and a covered multihole self-expandable metal stent (SEMS) (HANAROSTENT Biliary Multihole Benefit) was deployed across the distal biliary stricture using an ultra-slim 5.9-Fr delivery system compatible with the 3.2-mm working channel. Stent placement was technically successful without adverse events, resulting in prompt resolution of cholangitis and enabling the initiation of second-line chemotherapy. This case highlights a practical and reproducible strategy that expands the therapeutic capability of standard forward-viewing endoscopes. The combination of a slim delivery system and covered multihole SEMS may provide a physiological alternative to non-transpapillary drainage in selected patients with MBO and advanced type I duodenal stenosis.
abstract.zh: 恶性胆道梗阻（MBO）合并Ⅰ型十二指肠狭窄是一种技术要求较高的临床情形，因为管腔狭窄常使标准侧视十二指肠镜无法通过，从而限制常规经乳头引流。尽管内镜超声引导下胆道引流和经皮经肝胆道引流是已确立的替代方法，但在能够到达乳头时，经乳头引流仍是理想选择。我们报告了一名66岁Ⅳ期胰腺癌女性患者，表现为梗阻性黄疸及肿瘤相关Ⅰ型十二指肠狭窄，即梗阻位于乳头近端。侧视十二指肠镜无法通过狭窄处，但标准前视内镜（GIF-Q260J）成功到达十二指肠大乳头。完成选择性胆管插管后，使用与3.2 mm工作通道兼容的超细5.9 Fr输送系统，将多孔覆膜自膨式金属支架（SEMS；HANAROSTENT Biliary Multihole Benefit）跨远端胆管狭窄处释放。支架置入在技术上成功，未发生不良事件，胆管炎迅速缓解，患者得以开始二线化疗。本病例展示了一种实用且可重复的策略，可扩展标准前视内镜的治疗能力。对于经过选择的MBO合并重度Ⅰ型十二指肠狭窄患者，细径输送系统联合多孔覆膜SEMS可提供一种符合生理引流路径的选择，作为非经乳头引流的替代方案。

title.en: Crystal Violet Staining for Colitis-associated Neoplasia-guided Delineation of Ulcerative Colitis-associated Neoplasia for Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection: A Four-case Report
title.zh: 采用结肠炎相关肿瘤结晶紫染色界定溃疡性结肠炎相关肿瘤的内镜黏膜下剥离范围：4例报告

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Ulcerative colitis-associated neoplasia (UCAN) is often difficult to delineate because chronic inflammatory changes obscure lesion borders. Accurate assessment of lesion extent is essential for curative endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD), yet conventional white-light imaging frequently fails to clearly define lateral tumor spread. We report four patients with UCAN in whom crystal violet staining for colitis-associated neoplasia (CV-SCAN) was used to delineate lesion extent before ESD. All patients had ulcerative colitis in clinical remission and underwent surveillance colonoscopy. In these four patients, UCAN was identified as CV-neoplasia (CV-N) areas during CV-SCAN, whereas lesion borders remained indistinct on conventional white-light imaging. After histological confirmation by targeted biopsy, a repeat CV-SCAN was performed to determine lesion extent before ESD. In three patients, the CV-N-positive areas corresponded well with the pathological extent of neoplasia, and en bloc curative resection was achieved. One patient had a positive horizontal margin after the initial ESD. During an additional procedure, residual UCAN was again visualized as a CV-N-positive area and was successfully removed by additional ESD. No procedure-related adverse events or local recurrences were observed during follow-up. These cases suggest that CV-SCAN may facilitate delineation of UCAN before ESD and may help identify residual neoplasia that is difficult to recognize using white-light imaging alone. CV-SCAN should be considered an adjunctive technique that complements conventional endoscopic modalities rather than a standalone approach for lesion delineation.
abstract.zh: 由于慢性炎症改变会掩盖病变边界，溃疡性结肠炎相关肿瘤（UCAN）往往难以界定范围。准确评估病变范围对于实现根治性内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）至关重要，但常规白光成像经常无法清楚显示肿瘤的侧向扩展。我们报告了4例UCAN患者，在ESD前使用结肠炎相关肿瘤结晶紫染色（CV-SCAN）界定病变范围。所有患者的溃疡性结肠炎均处于临床缓解期，并接受监测性结肠镜检查。在这4例患者中，CV-SCAN将UCAN显示为CV肿瘤阳性（CV-N）区域，而常规白光成像下病变边界仍不清楚。靶向活检经组织学确认后，再次进行CV-SCAN，以在ESD前确定病变范围。其中3例的CV-N阳性区域与病理所见肿瘤范围吻合良好，并实现了整块根治性切除。另1例首次ESD后水平切缘阳性。在追加操作中，残留UCAN再次表现为CV-N阳性区域，并通过追加ESD成功切除。随访期间未观察到操作相关不良事件或局部复发。这些病例提示，CV-SCAN可能有助于在ESD前界定UCAN范围，并识别仅凭白光成像难以发现的残留肿瘤。CV-SCAN应被视为补充常规内镜技术的辅助手段，而非独立用于界定病变范围的方法。

title.en: CRFTrans: A recursive vision transformer reformulating the mean-field inference in conditional random field for medical image segmentation
title.zh: CRFTrans：通过重构条件随机场均值场推断实现医学图像分割的递归视觉Transformer

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Transformers have recently revolutionised medical image segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in many clinical applications. However, prevailing architectures relying on cascaded Transformer layers (e.g., 12-layer Vision Transformer) face practical limitations, leading to high computational cost and parameter redundancy. In this work, we present a new perspective that interprets Transformer operations through the paradigm of probabilistic inference. Specifically, we reveal a structural correspondence between Transformer blocks and mean-field inference in fully connected Conditional Random Fields (CRFs). Based on this insight, we propose CRFTrans, a recursive Transformer layer that reformulates the mean-field inference process using learnable attention and feed-forward operations. Unlike traditional CRFs that rely on fixed Gaussian kernels, CRFTrans leverages self-attention to model adaptive pairwise relationships in a high-dimensional feature space, enabling more expressive and data-driven contextual reasoning. We replace cascaded Transformer layers with CRFTrans in multiple state-of-the-art segmentation models and evaluate on five public datasets. Results show comparable or improved performance with significantly fewer parameters, lower memory usage, and faster training. CRFTrans provides a mathematically grounded, lightweight foundation for resource-constrained clinical deployments. The code is available in this GitHub link https://github.com/naisops/CRFTrans/tree/main.
abstract.zh: 近年来，Transformer革新了医学图像分割，在许多临床应用中达到当前最先进（SOTA）的性能。然而，依赖级联Transformer层的主流架构，例如12层视觉Transformer，存在实际应用局限，包括计算成本高和参数冗余。本研究提出一种新视角，从概率推断范式解释Transformer运算。具体而言，我们揭示了Transformer模块与全连接条件随机场（CRF）中的均值场推断之间的结构对应关系。基于这一认识，我们提出CRFTrans：一种递归Transformer层，通过可学习的注意力和前馈运算重新构建均值场推断过程。传统CRF依赖固定高斯核，而CRFTrans利用自注意力在高维特征空间中建模自适应成对关系，从而实现表达能力更强、由数据驱动的上下文推理。我们在多个最先进分割模型中用CRFTrans替换级联Transformer层，并在5个公开数据集上进行评估。结果显示，在参数显著减少、内存占用更低且训练速度更快的同时，性能与原模型相当或更优。CRFTrans为资源受限的临床部署提供了具有数学依据的轻量化基础。代码地址为：https://github.com/naisops/CRFTrans/tree/main。

title.en: Improvement of KLMS algorithm based on attention mechanism
title.zh: 基于注意力机制改进KLMS算法

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: This paper proposes an attention-augmented kernel adaptive filtering framework that enhances the Kernel Least Mean Square (KLMS) algorithm by explicitly incorporating data-dependent attention mechanisms into its update structure. By reinterpreting the KLMS recursion from an attention perspective, an additive attention-based variant, termed AttKLMS, is developed to dynamically regulate the contribution of historical samples during online learning. This design effectively combines the nonlinear modeling capability of kernel methods with the adaptive focusing property of attention, leading to improved convergence behavior and robustness under noisy conditions. To further address the computational burden and dimensionality challenges encountered in high-dimensional scenarios, a self-attention-based extension, referred to as Self-AttKLMS, is introduced as a learnable front-end representation module. Unlike fixed dimensionality reduction techniques, self-attention enables instance-wise and data-adaptive feature aggregation prior to kernel evaluation, thereby reducing model complexity while preserving essential information for filtering. Extensive experiments conducted on both one-dimensional chaotic time series (Mackey-Glass and Lorenz) and two-dimensional millimeter-wave imaging datasets demonstrate that the proposed methods consistently outperform conventional KLMS variants in terms of prediction accuracy, convergence stability, and noise robustness. The results further indicate that the proposed attention-augmented kernel adaptive filtering framework provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to existing kernel-based and deep learning approaches in online sequence prediction tasks.
abstract.zh: 本文提出一种注意力增强的核自适应滤波框架，通过在更新结构中显式引入依赖数据的注意力机制，改进核最小均方（KLMS）算法。通过从注意力视角重新解释KLMS递推，构建了基于加性注意力的变体AttKLMS，用于在在线学习过程中动态调节历史样本的贡献。该设计将核方法的非线性建模能力与注意力的自适应聚焦特性有效结合，改善了含噪条件下的收敛表现和稳健性。为进一步应对高维场景中的计算负担和维度挑战，本文引入基于自注意力的扩展Self-AttKLMS，作为可学习的前端表征模块。不同于固定的降维技术，自注意力在核计算之前进行逐实例、数据自适应的特征聚合，在保留滤波关键信息的同时降低模型复杂度。在一维混沌时间序列（Mackey-Glass和Lorenz）与二维毫米波成像数据集上开展的大量实验表明，所提方法在预测精度、收敛稳定性和噪声稳健性方面均持续优于传统KLMS变体。结果还表明，对于在线序列预测任务，该注意力增强核自适应滤波框架可作为现有核方法与深度学习方法的一种有效且计算高效的替代方案。

title.en: Click chemistry-modified cardiomyocytes enhance cardiac contractility and prevent remodeling in ischemia-reperfusion injured hearts
title.zh: 点击化学修饰的心肌细胞增强心脏收缩能力并抑制缺血再灌注损伤心脏的重构

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: One of the challenges in cardiac cell therapy using cardiomyocytes derived from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSC-CMs) is their poor engraftment and survival rate in infarcted tissues. Click chemistry and lipid insertion are simple methods for modifying the surface of hPSC-CMs with a collagen hybridizing peptide (CHP), providing binding motifs to increase their retention and engraftment in fibrotic hearts after ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury. In this study, we developed CHP-modified CMs (CHP-mCMs) to attach cells to damaged collagen in infarcted tissues. We injected CHP-mCMs into the border zone of infarcted hearts 7 days post-MI and evaluated cardiac function for 6 weeks. Serial echocardiography revealed that CHP-mCMs not only improved cardiac function but also reduced adverse remodeling in I/R-injured hearts. These findings indicate that CHP-mCM transplantation was associated with enhanced engraftment, reduced adverse remodeling, and improved cardiac function in the rat I/R model.
abstract.zh: 使用人多能干细胞来源心肌细胞（hPSC-CM）进行心脏细胞治疗的挑战之一，是这些细胞在梗死组织中的植入率和存活率较低。点击化学和脂质插入是利用胶原杂交肽（CHP）修饰hPSC-CM表面的简便方法，可提供结合基序，提高细胞在缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤后纤维化心脏中的滞留和植入。本研究开发了CHP修饰心肌细胞（CHP-mCM），使细胞附着于梗死组织中受损的胶原。我们在心肌梗死（MI）后第7天将CHP-mCM注射至梗死心脏的边缘区，并在6周内评估心功能。连续超声心动图检查显示，CHP-mCM不仅改善了心功能，还减少了I/R损伤心脏的不良重构。这些结果表明，在大鼠I/R模型中，CHP-mCM移植与植入增强、不良重构减少及心功能改善相关。

title.en: FL-SEHGT: Federated Learning-Based Heterogeneous Graph Transformer with Squeeze-and-Excitation for ASD Identification
title.zh: FL-SEHGT：用于自闭症谱系障碍识别的基于联邦学习并结合压缩激励机制的异构图Transformer

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder associated with widespread functional brain changes. Although deep learning has advanced computer-aided diagnosis of ASD using neuroimaging data, three key challenges remain: limited classification accuracy due to inadequate feature extraction, underexplored model interpretability that impedes understanding of the underlying neural mechanisms, and privacy concerns over multi-site data sharing that constrain practical deployment of collaborative diagnostic models. To address these challenges, we propose a federated learning-based squeeze-and-excitation heterogeneous graph transformer (FL-SEHGT) that utilizes resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) data to improve diagnostic accuracy relative to the evaluated federated baselines, enhance interpretability, and enable collaborative multi-site training without centralizing raw neuroimaging data. Experimental results on 871 subjects from 17 ABIDE I sites show that FL-SEHGT achieves a mean site accuracy of 63.45% across all 17 sites and 70.54% across the 10 sites with more than 40 subjects each, outperforming graph-augmentation-guided federated knowledge distillation (GAFD) (60.11%, 58.63%) and local-global federated learning (LG-FedAvg) (52.61%, 57.11%) on the corresponding site groups. The 10-site result also surpasses traditional models trained independently at each site (which achieved accuracies of 63.4%, 55.7%, and 60.2%). In a pooled five-fold evaluation, the proposed SEHGT attains an AUC of 71.7%. Altered functional connectivity patterns predominantly involving the default mode, cerebellar, and executive-control networks are identified as candidate neuroimaging features associated with ASD diagnosis. In summary, FL-SEHGT offers an effective, interpretable, and privacy-preserving framework for neuroimaging-based computer-aided diagnosis of ASD.
abstract.zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种与广泛脑功能改变相关的神经发育障碍。尽管深度学习推进了利用神经影像数据开展ASD计算机辅助诊断，但仍存在三个主要挑战：特征提取不足导致分类准确率有限；模型可解释性探索不足，妨碍对潜在神经机制的理解；多中心数据共享的隐私问题限制了协作诊断模型的实际部署。为应对这些挑战，我们提出基于联邦学习、结合压缩激励机制的异构图Transformer（FL-SEHGT），利用静息态功能磁共振成像（rsfMRI）数据，相对于所评估的联邦基线模型提高诊断准确率、增强可解释性，并在无需集中原始神经影像数据的情况下支持多中心协作训练。对ABIDE I中17个中心871名受试者的实验表明，FL-SEHGT在全部17个中心的平均中心准确率为63.45%，在每个中心超过40名受试者的10个中心中为70.54%；相应中心分组的结果均优于图增强引导的联邦知识蒸馏（GAFD，60.11%、58.63%）和局部—全局联邦学习（LG-FedAvg，52.61%、57.11%）。10个中心的结果还优于在各中心独立训练的传统模型，其准确率分别为63.4%、55.7%和60.2%。在合并数据的五折评估中，所提出的SEHGT达到71.7%的AUC。研究发现，主要涉及默认模式网络、小脑网络和执行控制网络的功能连接改变，可作为与ASD诊断相关的候选神经影像特征。综上，FL-SEHGT为基于神经影像的ASD计算机辅助诊断提供了一个有效、可解释且保护隐私的框架。

title.en: Cationized gelatin nanosphere-mediated release-controlled RNA interference targeting mTORC1 protects against intervertebral disc degeneration
title.zh: 阳离子化明胶纳米球介导的靶向mTORC1控释RNA干扰可防止椎间盘退变

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Intervertebral disc degeneration is a major cause of chronic low back pain, but effective disease-modifying therapies remain unavailable. Sustained and localized RNA interference (RNAi) offers a promising therapeutic approach; however, its application to the disc is limited by poor local retention and delivery-related toxicity. Here, we developed a release-controlled RNAi platform using biodegradable cationized gelatin nanospheres (cGNS) to deliver small interfering RNA (siRNA) targeting  Rptor , which encodes RPTOR, a key component of the mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1). cGNS enabled longer-term intracellular siRNA retention with lower toxicity than conventional lipofection, leading to a prolonged decrease in RPTOR expression, autophagy activation, and suppressed apoptosis, senescence, and matrix breakdown. Intradiscal delivery of  Rptor  siRNA with cGNS preserved radiographic tissue morphology, maintained histological matrix integrity, and reduced cellular degeneration markers. Benefits were observed in both preventive and post-traumatic settings. cGNS-mediated controlled release of RNAi against  Rptor  is a durable therapeutic strategy for degenerative disc disease through mTORC1 inhibition.
abstract.zh: 椎间盘退变是慢性下腰痛的主要原因之一，但目前仍缺乏能够有效改变疾病进程的治疗方法。持续且局部化的RNA干扰（RNAi）是一种有前景的治疗策略，然而其在椎间盘中的应用受到局部滞留不足和递送相关毒性的限制。本研究使用可生物降解的阳离子化明胶纳米球（cGNS），建立了控释RNAi平台，用于递送靶向Rptor的小干扰RNA（siRNA）；Rptor编码RPTOR，后者是雷帕霉素机制靶蛋白复合物1（mTORC1）的关键组成部分。与常规脂质体转染相比，cGNS使siRNA在细胞内滞留更久且毒性更低，从而持续降低RPTOR表达、激活自噬，并抑制细胞凋亡、衰老和基质降解。通过cGNS将Rptor siRNA递送至椎间盘内，可保留影像学所示组织形态、维持组织学基质完整性，并减少细胞退变标志物。在预防性和创伤后干预情境中均观察到益处。cGNS介导的靶向Rptor控释RNAi通过抑制mTORC1，为退行性椎间盘疾病提供了一种持久的治疗策略。

abstract.en: Introduction Bladder MRI-guided online adaptive radiotherapy (MRIgART) has enabled a reduction in planning target volume (PTV) margins, reducing normal tissue irradiation. Yet, further margin reduction is limited due to workflow duration and intra-fractional bladder variation. This study reports the feasibility of a 5 mm isotropic PTV in whole bladder MRIgART, 55 Gy in 20 fractions daily, and 36 Gy in 6 fractions weekly, with a personalised approach to margin expansion. Methods Patients voided their bladders prior to treatment. Following setup, a daily MRI (MR DAILY ) was acquired, and an adaptive workflow was performed. An MRI was acquired during delivery to coincide with treatment completion (MR POST ). Time from MR DAILY  to MR POST  was recorded. Offline, target coverage of the clinical target volume (CTV) was visually monitored by comparing MR DAILY  and MR POST  images. Images were reviewed by the radiation oncologist (RO) if the CTV was outside of the PTV on the MR POST . Under RO discretion, margins were personalised to the minimum margin that would have encompassed the CTV and applied online for subsequent fractions. In retrospective analysis, MR POST  CTVs were recontoured, and the adaptive plan recalculated. CTV coverage was deemed acceptable if V95% ≥ 95%. If this objective was not met, the gross tumour volume (GTV) was delineated and the dose reported; coverage was deemed acceptable if GTV V95% ≥ 95%. Results A total of 138 fractions from ten patients were analysed. Median (interquartile range) workflow time was 25.6 (20.8-30.7) minutes. PTV margins were personalised for 31 fractions in three patients. 119 MR POST  images were available for analysis. CTV coverage was achieved in 94% (112/119) of fractions. Where the CTV mandatory objectives were missed (6%; 7/119 fractions), GTV coverage was acceptable in 6 of the 7 fractions. Conclusion Whole bladder MRIgART with 5 mm isotropic PTV margins with a personalised approach to margin expansion is feasible in achieving acceptable CTV coverage.
abstract.zh: 引言：膀胱磁共振引导在线自适应放疗（MRIgART）使规划靶体积（PTV）外扩边界得以缩小，从而减少正常组织受照。但治疗流程持续时间和分次内膀胱变化限制了进一步缩小外扩边界。本研究报告在全膀胱MRIgART中采用各向同性5 mm PTV外扩边界，并实施个体化边界扩展的可行性；治疗方案为每日分次、20次共55 Gy，以及每周分次、6次共36 Gy。方法：患者在治疗前排空膀胱。摆位后采集每日MRI（MR DAILY），并执行自适应治疗流程。在照射过程中采集MRI，使其采集时间与治疗完成相吻合（MR POST），并记录从MR DAILY至MR POST的时间。在离线分析中，通过对比MR DAILY和MR POST图像，目视监测临床靶体积（CTV）的靶区覆盖情况。如果MR POST中CTV超出PTV，由放射肿瘤科医师（RO）复核图像。根据RO判断，将边界个体化调整为足以包容CTV的最小外扩距离，并在线应用于后续分次。回顾性分析中，重新勾画MR POST上的CTV，并重新计算自适应计划。当V95%≥95%时，认为CTV覆盖可接受。若未达此目标，则勾画大体肿瘤体积（GTV）并报告剂量；当GTV V95%≥95%时，认为GTV覆盖可接受。结果：分析了10名患者的138个分次。治疗流程时间的中位数（四分位距）为25.6（20.8–30.7）分钟。3名患者的31个分次进行了PTV边界个体化调整。119幅MR POST图像可供分析，其中94%（112/119）的分次达到了CTV覆盖要求。在未满足CTV必需目标的7个分次（6%；7/119）中，有6个分次的GTV覆盖可接受。结论：全膀胱MRIgART采用各向同性5 mm PTV外扩边界，结合个体化边界扩展，可实现可接受的CTV覆盖，具有可行性。

title.en: Prevalence and Clinical Significance of Gastric-Type Mucosal Lesions in Non-Ampullary Duodenal Epithelial Tumors Based on Mucin Phenotype
title.zh: 基于黏蛋白表型评估非乳头部十二指肠上皮性肿瘤中胃型黏膜病变的患病情况及临床意义

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Objectives Non-ampullary duodenal epithelial tumors differ in clinicopathological features according to mucin phenotype. Gastric-type tumors have distinct biological features; however, their associated mucosal background remains unclear. In this study, gastric foveolar metaplasia, gastric heterotopia, and Brunner's gland hyperplasia were collectively referred to as gastric-type mucosal lesions (G-MLs). We aimed to assess their prevalence and associations with mucin phenotype and clinicopathological factors. Methods We retrospectively analyzed the data of 130 patients with 130 resected non-ampullary duodenal epithelial tumors at a single center. Tumors were classified according to mucin phenotype. The prevalence of concomitant G-MLs and associated factors was evaluated. Exploratory Firth-penalized logistic regression analysis was used to assess the association between gastric-type tumors and G-ML presence. Results Concomitant G-MLs were identified in 44 patients (33.8%). Their prevalence was higher in gastric-type tumors (13/16; 81.3%) than in gastric-intestinal-type tumors (10/37; 27.0%) and intestinal-type tumors (21/77; 27.3%). G-MLs were associated with mild endoscopic gastric mucosal atrophy and smoking status and were inversely associated with current  Helicobacter pylori  infection. In the exploratory fully adjusted model, gastric-type tumors remained positively associated with the presence of G-MLs (adjusted odds ratio, 7.00; 95% confidence interval, 1.98-30.95;  p  = 0.002). Conclusions G-MLs were present in approximately one-third of patients and were most frequent in gastric-type tumors. These findings indicate an association between G-MLs and gastric-type tumors; however, the cross-sectional design does not allow inference of a biological relationship. Trial registration N/A.
abstract.zh: 目的：非乳头部十二指肠上皮性肿瘤的临床病理特征随黏蛋白表型而异。胃型肿瘤具有独特的生物学特征，但其相关黏膜背景尚不明确。本研究将胃小凹化生、胃黏膜异位和Brunner腺增生统称为胃型黏膜病变（G-ML）。我们旨在评估其检出比例，以及其与黏蛋白表型和临床病理因素的关联。方法：单中心回顾性分析130名患者的130个已切除非乳头部十二指肠上皮性肿瘤。根据黏蛋白表型对肿瘤分类，评估伴发G-ML的比例及相关因素。采用探索性Firth惩罚逻辑回归分析，评估胃型肿瘤与G-ML存在之间的关联。结果：44名患者（33.8%）存在伴发G-ML。胃型肿瘤中的伴发比例为13/16（81.3%），高于胃肠型肿瘤的10/37（27.0%）和肠型肿瘤的21/77（27.3%）。G-ML与内镜下轻度胃黏膜萎缩及吸烟状态相关，与当前幽门螺杆菌感染呈负相关。在探索性的充分调整模型中，胃型肿瘤仍与G-ML存在呈正相关，调整后比值比为7.00，95%置信区间为1.98–30.95，p=0.002。结论：约三分之一患者存在G-ML，在胃型肿瘤中最常见。这些结果提示G-ML与胃型肿瘤存在关联，但横断面研究设计不能据此推断两者的生物学关系。试验注册：不适用。

title.en: Spatial mechanopriming of multicellular interfaces drives cytoskeletal-to-nuclear remodeling to boost therapeutic efficacy of stem cells
title.zh: 多细胞界面的空间力学预激通过驱动细胞骨架至细胞核的重塑增强干细胞治疗效能

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Engineering multicellular constructs through biophysical cues, independent of soluble biochemical factors, is a promising strategy to boost the therapeutic potential of stem cells for regenerative medicine. However, the mechanisms by which spatially organized cell-cell and cell-matrix interfaces govern multicellular signaling and subsequent behavioral outcomes remain poorly understood. Here, we elucidate these mechanistic events by introducing 2D nanoplates (∼350 nm) compartmentalized within the intercellular space of mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) spheroids to form  de novo  cell-matrix spatial interfaces. These interfaces redistribute internal stress across the spheroid, amplifying integrin-cytoskeleton-nucleus force transmission and restoring YAP-dependent mechanotransduction to achieve spatial mechanopriming. Cells within these mechanoprimed spheroids exhibit profound nuclear deformation, epigenetic remodeling, and spatially patterned metabolic activation. Finite element modeling and spatial transcriptomic analyses further reveal a spheroid-wide reorganization of cytoskeletal and transcriptional networks. Mechanistically, elevated cytoskeletal tension across the reorganized interfaces is associated with a putative, tension-associated pseudo-hypoxic signature involving HIF-1α-related signaling, establishing a mechanometabolic niche that robustly enhances angiogenic secretion. Consequently, mechanoprimed spheroids demonstrate superior engraftment, accelerated vascular regeneration, and improved perfusion recovery in a murine ischemia model. Collectively, this work establishes spatial mechanopriming as an effective strategy to remodel cytoskeletal-to-nuclear mechanics and enhance the therapeutic potential of 3D multicellular systems.
abstract.zh: 利用生物物理线索而不依赖可溶性生化因子来构建多细胞结构，是提高干细胞再生医学治疗潜能的一种有前景的策略。然而，空间组织化的细胞—细胞及细胞—基质界面如何调控多细胞信号传导与后续行为结果，其机制仍不清楚。本研究将二维纳米片（约350 nm）分区置于间充质干细胞（MSC）球体的细胞间隙内，形成新的细胞—基质空间界面，以阐明这些机制。这些界面重新分配球体内部应力，增强整合素—细胞骨架—细胞核的力传递，并恢复依赖YAP的力学信号转导，从而实现空间力学预激。经过这种力学预激的球体内，细胞表现出显著的细胞核形变、表观遗传重塑及具有空间模式的代谢激活。有限元建模和空间转录组分析进一步揭示了遍及球体的细胞骨架网络与转录网络重组。在机制层面，重组界面上增强的细胞骨架张力，与一种推测的、涉及HIF-1α相关信号的张力相关假性缺氧特征有关，形成显著增强促血管生成分泌功能的力学—代谢微环境。因此，在小鼠缺血模型中，经过力学预激的球体表现出更好的植入、加快的血管再生和改善的灌注恢复。总体而言，本研究确立了空间力学预激作为一种有效策略，可重塑细胞骨架至细胞核的力学传递，并增强三维多细胞系统的治疗潜能。

title.en: Recent advances in functionalized electrospun nanofibers for biomedical and therapeutic applications: A comprehensive review
title.zh: 用于生物医学和治疗的功能化静电纺丝纳米纤维研究进展：综合综述

review.method: Compared the complete English source and Chinese draft for meaning, study design, numerical results, uncertainty, and conclusion strength. Same assistant; no independent human review.

abstract.en: Electrospun nanofibers (ESNFs) have become a major focus of modern research given their adaptable architecture, extensive interface, and distinctive physicochemical characteristics, making them appropriate for varied applications such as catalysis and environmental cleanup, drug delivery (DD), tissue engineering (TE), sensing, actuation, and various energy-related technologies. As a result, electrospinning (ES) has emerged as a versatile manufacturing technique, driving intensive efforts to engineer nanofibrous structures specifically for biomedical purposes. Functionalization of ESNFs can be achieved by embedding functional agents or altering surface chemistry to introduce specific functionalities. This review discusses the fabrication methods, optimization techniques, and broad biomedical applications of modified ESNFs, emphasizing their key properties, including biocompatibility, degradability, and safety profile. The article outlines various strategies for creating and modifying ESNFs, followed by a comprehensive analysis of their applications in tissue regeneration, DD, wound repair, antimicrobial therapy, cancer diagnostics and treatment, and biosensing. By critically evaluating recent advances, highlighting future directions, and addressing ongoing challenges about ES, this review underscores the transformative potential of functionalized ESNFs as efficient and adaptable biomaterials for biomedical technologies.
abstract.zh: 静电纺丝纳米纤维（ESNF）具有可调节的结构、广阔的界面和独特的理化性质，适用于催化与环境净化、药物递送（DD）、组织工程（TE）、传感、驱动及多种能源相关技术，因此已成为现代研究的重要方向。由此，静电纺丝（ES）发展为一种多用途制造技术，并推动了针对生物医学用途设计纳米纤维结构的大量研究。通过嵌入功能性组分或改变表面化学，可赋予ESNF特定功能。本综述讨论改性ESNF的制备方法、优化技术及广泛的生物医学应用，重点介绍其生物相容性、可降解性和安全性等关键特征。文章概述制备与改性ESNF的各种策略，随后全面分析其在组织再生、药物递送、创伤修复、抗菌治疗、癌症诊断与治疗以及生物传感中的应用。通过批判性评估近期进展、指出未来方向并讨论静电纺丝仍面临的挑战，本综述强调了功能化ESNF作为高效、适应性强的生物材料，推动生物医学技术变革的潜力。
